title: Yes We Can Driving School
page-intro: Empowering journeys, mastering roads: where every drive is a success story.
welcome-message: Welcome to Yes We Can Driving School
welcome-content: At Yes We Can Driving School, we believe in empowering individuals to become safe and confident drivers. With a proud history of serving our community, we are committed to providing top-quality driver education that exceeds expectations.
about-content1: Our team of experienced instructors brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the driver's seat. Fluent in both English and Korean, our instructors create a supportive learning environment where students of all backgrounds feel comfortable and confident behind the wheel.
about-title2: Why Choose Yes We Can Driving School?
about-content2-1: Benefit from our team's collective knowledge and expertise gained from years of teaching and mentoring aspiring drivers.
about-content2-2: We understand that every student is unique. That's why we tailor our lessons to meet your individual needs and learning style.
about-content2-3: Whether you're a beginner or looking to upgrade your skills, our courses cover everything from the basics to advanced driving techniques.
about-content2-4: With flexible scheduling options, we make it easy for you to fit driver education into your busy lifestyle.
about-content2-5: Our instructors ensure that language is never a barrier to learning. Feel at ease knowing that instruction is available in both English and Korean.
about-content3: Ready to embark on your journey towards becoming a safe and skilled driver? Call us at Yes We Can Driving School and let us help you achieve your driving goals. Contact us today to schedule your first lesson!

instructor-title: Expert Instruction & Encouragement for Confident, Safe Drivers
instructor-p1: At Yes We Can Driving School, our team of certified ICBC instructors brings extensive teaching expertise to every lesson. Whether you are a beginner or adapting to Canadian roads, we tailor each session to your learning pace in a calm, supportive environment.
instructor-p2: We thoroughly analyze the latest ICBC road test routes and point-deduction criteria, ensuring students develop safe habits and pass their road test with complete confidence.
courses-title: Structured Curriculum Tailored to Your Skill Level & Goals
courses-subtitle: From beginner drivers to license conversion and mock test simulations, we cover every aspect of safe driving.
course1-desc: Master car controls, parallel parking, 2/3-point turns, hill parking, shoulder checks, intersection scans, and verbal hazard perception.
course1-points: Master all essential ICBC road test marking criteria
Foolproof parallel and reverse stall parking formulas
Right-of-way rules, school zones, and pedestrian safety
course2-desc: High-speed highway merging (Highway 1), multi-lane dynamic traffic navigation, complex left turns, and unlearning dangerous driving habits.
course2-points: Safe highway merging and speed adaptation
Judging gaps and timing on busy multi-lane intersections
course3-title: Mock Road Test & Test-Day Car Rental
course3-desc: Full simulated road test using official ICBC score sheets + warm-up lesson before the test and dual-brake car rental for test day.
course3-points: Simulated drive on actual Port Coquitlam ICBC test routes
Pre-test warm-up lesson to shake off test anxiety
ICBC-approved dual-control vehicle rental for test day
course4-desc: Learn BC traffic laws, 4-way stops, roundabouts, school zones, and safe driving tips for wet Pacific Northwest rain and winter weather.
course4-points: Key differences between Canadian and international traffic rules
Techniques for driving safely in heavy rain and dark winter evenings

reviews-title: Real Test Pass Stories from Our Students
reviews-subtitle: Here is what our students have to say about their experience learning with Instructor Kim.
review1-text: Passed my Class 5 road test on the first try at Port Coquitlam ICBC! The instructor showed me all the tricky spots, school zone traps, and exact shoulder check timings. I felt completely prepared!
review2-text: I used to be terrified of driving, but Instructor Kim was so remarkably calm and patient. Being able to learn in Korean helped me understand every technical nuance without stress. Highly recommend!
review3-text: I had driven in Korea for years, but Canadian 4-way stops and bike lanes were new to me. In just two lessons, he fixed my blind spots and I aced my road test effortlessly!
faq-subtitle: Have questions before booking? Here are common answers. You can also reach out anytime.
faq-q1: How do I schedule my first lesson?
faq-a1: Simply call +1 604-816-7070 or message us via KakaoTalk open chat. We will coordinate your preferred date, time, and pick-up location promptly.
faq-q2: Can I rent your vehicle for my official ICBC road test?
faq-a2: Yes! We offer a dedicated Road Test Package that includes a pre-test warm-up session and rental of our dual-brake car for your test at the Port Coquitlam ICBC location.
faq-q3: Do you provide door-to-door pick-up and drop-off?
faq-a3: Yes, complimentary pick-up and drop-off from your home, school, or workplace is included across Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, and Port Moody. Outer areas can also be arranged.
faq-q4: Are lessons conducted in English or Korean?
faq-a4: Our instructor is completely fluent in both English and Korean. You can choose whichever language feels most natural, and we practice English test commands commonly given by ICBC examiners.
faq-q5: What is your cancellation and rescheduling policy?
faq-a5: Please notify us at least 24 hours in advance so we can adjust the schedule smoothly without cancellation fees.
